works.author: Ronan Flynn-Curran
works.comment: 把 AI 设计协作的「过程」画成一张决策地图，用线程式画布让每次 prompt、迭代与评审都有迹可循，值得借鉴的是为 agent 工作流设计专属的可视化语言，而不只是展示最终稿。
works.comment_en: It turns the 'process' of AI design collaboration into a decision map — a threaded canvas where every prompt, iteration, and review leaves a trace. The takeaway: design a dedicated visual language for agent workflows, not just the final output.
works.title: Takes - a decision map for design agents

works.author: JOY - Product Designer
works.comment: 用自然语言搜索、AI 匹配分与 12 个月价格预测把找房变成「被 AI 陪着看房」，值得借鉴的是把 AI 能力包装成可感知的分数和行动建议，而非堆砌功能点。
works.comment_en: Natural-language search, AI match scores, and 12-month price forecasts turn house-hunting into 'an AI accompanies your viewing.' The lesson: package AI capability as perceivable scores and action suggestions, not a pile of features.
works.title: AI Real Estate App UI Design | Smart Home Finder Mobile App

works.author: 10am Space
works.comment: 以「大标题＋真实家长证言＋FAQ」三段式结构直击家长的决策焦虑，值得借鉴的是用编辑杂志式的排版节奏和暖橙色建立信任感，让落地页像一本可信的育儿刊物。
works.comment_en: A three-part structure — big headline, real parent testimonials, FAQ — aimed straight at parents' decision anxiety. Worth borrowing: the editorial-magazine layout rhythm and warm orange that build trust, making the page read like a credible parenting journal.
works.title: Early Learning Landing Page

works.author: JOY - Product Designer
works.comment: 深海军蓝配紫橙渐变让金融数据有了高级感，更值得借鉴的是「可解释 AI」设计——把估值拆成地段、市场动量等可视化驱动因素，用透明度换取用户对 AI 定价的信任。
works.comment_en: Deep navy with purple-orange gradients gives financial data a premium feel — but the bigger lesson is 'explainable AI' design: breaking valuation into visualized drivers like location and market momentum, trading transparency for trust in AI pricing.
works.title: AI Property Valuation App UI | Dark Mode Real Estate Mobile App

works.author: Ronan Flynn-Curran
works.comment: 为 AI agent 打造的「动态流式」工作日志：把各 agent 的产出聚合成一条可浏览的任务动态，值得借鉴的是用信息流的心智模型解决「agent 在干什么」的可观测性问题，简洁又有产品味。
works.comment_en: A 'live-streaming' work log for AI agents: each agent's output aggregated into one browsable task feed. Worth borrowing: using the feed mental model to solve the 'what are the agents doing' observability problem — simple, with real product taste.
works.title: fleeet.space
